title: Confound test: neutral uniform roster, 4/6 wrong, evidence board vs mixed record

notes: Same scenarios, conditions, seeds, and initial beliefs as amplifier_majority_wrong_haiku_v1.
Changed variable: all 6 agents have identical neutral weights (no contamination bias, no specialist advantage).
If the evidence-board vs mixed-record gap disappears, the amplifier result was driven by role heterogeneity.
If the gap persists, the finding is about record design, not agent roles.
